items.question: Which WNBA teams did Alex Montgomery play for?
items.answer: The New York Liberty drafted Alex Montgomery 10th overall in 2011 out of Georgia Tech. She played for New York (2011 to 2014), San Antonio (2015 to 2017) and Chicago (2018), averaging 4.2 points over eight WNBA seasons.
